title: UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65%
summary: Bitcoin Magazine UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65% UniCredit began selling a six-year, capital-protected certificate linked to BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin ETP to retail clients in Italy, with gains capped at 65%. This post UniCredit Opens Bitcoin to Italian Savers, Capping Gains at 65% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
